column4: Full-body view of a brand new replacement doll, the same porcelain maid doll as in the reference sheet: same face, long orange hair, orange flower ornament with white center, black dress with white apron and ruffles, white boots, ball joints and wrist rings. Exactly two arms, two legs, two feet and five fingers per hand. She is freshly made: her porcelain is spotless, and her eyes are CLOSED with calm lashes, head bowed slightly, arms hanging loosely at her sides, legs together with toes pointing straight down as if hanging a little above the ground, skirt hanging still. Front view, the whole figure fits the frame with a small margin. The entire background is one flat pure chroma green (#00B140) with nothing else in it; the figure has a clean closed outline against it, no strings, no floor, no shadow, no text.

A single bare porcelain hand and forearm, large and centered, with the white glove removed: smooth ivory porcelain with ball joints at every finger knuckle and at the wrist, five distinct fingers, the hand hanging open with fingers relaxed, palm turned toward the viewer, the forearm entering from the top edge. Clean closed outline. The entire background is one flat pure chroma green (#00B140), no strings, no text.

Full-body view of the same living librarian as in the reference sheet and portrait: same face, long orange hair, orange flower ornament with white center, white blouse with black ribbon bow and orange brooch, layered black, ivory and orange skirt, ankle boots. She is a living human: natural skin, no ball joints, no wrist rings, no seams. Exactly two arms, two legs, two feet and five fingers per hand, both eyes visible when facing the camera. She stands upright and still, arms hanging relaxed, face tilted up toward the sky with a quiet, tired, searching expression, slight sorrow in the eyes. Front view. The whole figure fits the frame with a small margin. The entire background is one flat pure chroma green (#00B140) with nothing else in it; the figure has a clean closed outline against it, no strings, no floor, no shadow, no text.

Low three-quarter view of the cathedral stone floor. In the lower half a hooded kneeling congregant seen from the back, hands reaching down, arranging shards of colored glass on the floor. The shards form the first loose outline of a woman's face (an oval of orange and black glass pieces with a few gaps), taken from the stained-glass saint in the first reference. Scattered extra shards lie around. Dark nave, pews and pillars in the upper background, fully visible dark stone floor. Wide cinematic frame.

Same portrait framing and camera as the first reference: the librarian from the chest up on the ivory paper background, but now her raised hand is OPEN and empty, fingers loosely spread and relaxed as if she has just let go of something, palm turned down, no scissors anywhere. Her eyes are lowered, looking down at the floor, calm and resigned. Same face, flower ornament, hair and clothing. Both hands: only this one hand is in the frame. No text.

A single large pair of dressmaker's shears isolated at the center of the frame, blades closed and pointing down-left, black ring handles, at the same scale and style as the shears in the reference. Clean closed outline. The entire background is one flat pure chroma green (#00B140), no hand, no thread, no shadow, no text.

Full-body BACK view of the same living librarian as in the reference sheet and portrait: same face, long orange hair, orange flower ornament with white center, white blouse with black ribbon bow and orange brooch, layered black, ivory and orange skirt, ankle boots. She is a living human: natural skin, no ball joints, no wrist rings, no seams. Exactly two arms, two legs, two feet and five fingers per hand, both eyes visible when facing the camera. She walks away from the viewer, one step forward, hair falling down her back, shoulders slightly lowered, head slightly bowed. Back view as in the third figure of the reference. The whole figure fits the frame with a small margin. The entire background is one flat pure chroma green (#00B140) with nothing else in it; the figure has a clean closed outline against it, no strings, no floor, no shadow, no text.

Same locked camera and wall of small puppet theater cells as the reference. In one cell near the center-right a small porcelain maid doll sits inside and stretches one thin arm straight out horizontally through the cell opening toward the LEFT of the frame, the hand open with five fingers. All other cells stay empty. No strings, no text.

Same locked camera, lectern and open red book as the first reference. From the left edge of the frame a living librarian's hand with a white blouse cuff reaches in and rests its fingertips on the right-hand open page, the other pages still open and flat. Only her hand and forearm appear; five fingers, natural skin, no joints or rings. No text.
